items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: Frankie Deuston, Jimmy Palau, my brother, Victor Mineta, they're all raised.

ctx.x: Well, then you heard him when he came back, when the band came back? Oh, yeah, sure.

Because my brother had brought him out by the funky butt. My brother's a dancer. But my brother and Frankie Deuston, they come up together. They're raised up together now, geez. Frankie Deuston, Jimmy Palau, my brother, Victor Mineta, they're all raised. My brother was a dancer, though. They warned him he had a very good talent for music. He could play a nice cornet. But he didn't like that. He was a fellow who liked his hard work. He worked in SPR, 38 years.
